scope: Frozen original observation-reference protocol. Existing saved predictions only; no inference, optimizer update, test data or model selection in this audit.
aggregation: One window per recording; equal-recording mean and pooled joint/frame count weighted mean both retained. Hidden/visible denominators vary by window. No mix of validation panels in headline.

expanded_rich20.selection: First 20 new-recording entries of preregistered identity-only cohort; results were not used in selection. Remaining planned entries absent because interrupted. Not TEST or complete cohort.

development9.selection: Fixed development panel used for engineering acceptance; not independent heldout or TEST.

independent_CPU_check.formula: Independent float64 NumPy identity-residual 6D rotation Gram-Schmidt, 22-joint FK and direct error formulas, per-frame proper similarity PA, 30 Hz first/second differences.
independent_CPU_check.scope_limit: Saved inputs and source hashes checked; full sensor stream regeneration and recursive scene tensor input reconstruction not repeated. Existing paired recursive input fingerprint agreement remains inherited provenance. No GPU or inference.

temporal_rotation_diagnostics.definition: Each wrist global joint rotation: per-frame geodesic increment, 95th percentile within each window then equal-recording mean; increment error is geodesic angle between predicted and GT relative rotation increments. Position acceleration error is mean 30 Hz second-difference difference over left/right wrists. Not official benchmark and orientation can be underconstrained by positional EXO observations. P95 does not guarantee absence of rare jumps.

availability_definition: conditioned/visible means observation_meta[...,0] > 0. unconditioned/hidden means unavailable or missing 3D positional observation, which can include occlusion, field-of-view and measurement failures; it is not exclusively physical occlusion.
